title: Clean digital invoice - exact PO match
description: Apex Office Supplies bills PO-1001 in full. Machine-readable PDF, 4 itemised lines, IGST 18%.

title: Different layout - IT hardware, IGST
description: Brightline IT bills the laptop refresh (PO-1002). Modern layout with labels above values.

title: Small variance within tolerance
description: Freight rate billed at 48,700 vs 48,000 on PO-1003 (diesel revision). Total is 1.36% over PO - inside the 2% / Rs 5,000 tolerance, so approved but the variance stays visible.

title: Tax-inclusive prices + bundled line
description: Evergreen quotes GST-inclusive prices and bundles bubble wrap + tape into one line. The engine back-calculates tax and reconciles the bundle against two PO lines.

title: Partial invoice against a 3-month PO
description: Deccan bills month 1 of 3 on PO-1004 (intra-state, CGST + SGST). Approved and the PO's remaining balance drops by one month.

title: EDGE 2 - Invoice exceeds PO tolerance (Rs 1,08,000 vs Rs 1,00,000)
description: Falcon adds an unapproved 'design revisions' line. Invoice is Rs 8,000 (8%) above PO-1006, beyond the 2% / Rs 5,000 tolerance - routed to review with the exact variance.

title: EDGE 1 - Duplicate invoice (re-sent with a new filename)
description: Apex re-sends invoice APX/26-27/0412 as a payment reminder. Different file, same invoice. Run after sample 01.

title: EDGE 3 - Scanned invoice, smudged invoice no. and PO ref
description: A scanned paper invoice (no text layer). An ink smear covers the invoice number and PO number. OCR must not guess - uncertain fields go to a human, with PO candidates suggested.

title: EDGE 4 - Valid PO, wrong vendor
description: Coastal Logistics quotes PO-1007 - a real, open PO, but issued to Brightline IT. The PO match is refused, both identities shown, and Coastal's own open PO suggested.

title: Blocked vendor
description: Horizon Security is on compliance hold (GST returns not filed). Invoice is otherwise clean.

title: Look-alike vendor (possible impersonation)
description: 'Apex Office Supply Co.' - name 90%+ similar to a registered vendor, but a different GSTIN and bank account. Must not be treated as Apex.

title: Invoice against a closed PO
description: Jaipur Textiles bills PO-1013, which was fully received and closed in August.

title: Overseas vendor in USD (no GST)
description: US SaaS vendor, USD currency, EIN instead of GSTIN, reverse-charge note. Exact match to PO-1011.

title: Scanned invoice, readable - OCR happy path
description: A clean scan with no text layer. OCR reads every field with high confidence; 1 of 3 shipments on PO-1010.
